articles.title: Where Does Bitcoin Go From Here? This Is What the Charts Say
articles.snippet: Bitcoin just had its worst day since April. The death cross is in effect, and prediction markets are bearish.

articles.title: Anthropic Expands Access to Claude Mythos After AI Giant Files for IPO

articles.title: DuckDuckGo Launched Duck AI. Now Their Hit Product is 'No AI'
articles.snippet: As Google buries its search results under AI-generated answers, DuckDuckGo believes a growing number of users just want the old internet back.
